column1: #   canonical   the value MarkResolver reports / the primary spelling
#   aliases     pipe-separated extra spellings; canonical is matched too. Matching is
#               case-insensitive, trims whitespace, and treats "+"/" "/"-" as interchangeable
#   asset       filename stem under Assets/Marks/AgeRatings/ (<stem>.svg). Non-blank -> the mark
#               is that SVG (monochrome ESRB glyph, tinted by BrandMark). Blank -> letter chip.
#   chiptext    short text for the letter chip when there is no asset (blank -> use canonical)
#   bg          chip background hex (blank -> the neutral PbSurface3 / PbTextMuted chip)
# --- Icon tier: CE's 8 bundled AgeRatings/*.png labels, now ESRB "2013" vector (PD, Wikimedia) ---
# --- Chip tier: ComicInfo v2.1 AgeRating values with no ESRB equivalent ---
# (colour bands: green = family, amber = teen/older-teen, red = adult. Reviewable.)
# Unknown / blank -> MarkSpec.None (nothing renders); handled in code, not here.
